cohort: Pregnant patients (209 pregnancies from 176 patients) seen by a retina specialist or ophthalmologist for a retinal vascular disease or precursor at four tertiary care centers.
finding: Retinal vascular disease was confirmed in 35% of pregnancies, with significantly higher rates of preterm birth (54% vs 25%) and C-section delivery (78% vs 48%) in patients with the condition.
mod_finding: Rates of C-section delivery were significantly higher (78% vs 48%) in patients with a retinal vascular disease compared to those without.
